summary: First iteration test of Noleggio Nuovo (Italian bike rental, Expo+FastAPI+Mongo). Backend: 25/25 pytest tests PASSED covering auth (register/login/me/duplicate/bad creds), meta, bikes list/detail/filter/quote/past-date/outside-hours, bookings (store+hourly+daily, auth required, stock exhaustion -> 409, cancel + 409 on re-cancel), Stripe checkout session creation + status, admin stats/bookings list+filter/patch, admin bike CRUD + 403 for normal user. Frontend: catalog loads with 4 seeded bikes, category/size chips filter correctly, bike detail opens, guest 'Prenota ora' redirects to /login (PASS), store checkout flow completes to payment-result (PASS from first run - confirmed booking visible in Prenotazioni), admin area accessible only to admin, admin stats show 26 units/active=6/revenue, admin bike list with Modifica/Elimina + 'Aggiungi bici' FAB, admin booking tab switch works. Italian copy verified throughout. UX issue: after login from book-now flow user is returned to bike detail instead of auto-forwarded to checkout.

ui_bugs.issue: After unauthenticated user taps 'Prenota ora' then logs in, user is navigated back to bike detail (router.canGoBack->back) rather than auto-continuing to /checkout. User must tap 'Prenota ora' a second time. Minor UX friction, intent is lost.

issues: On 390x844 viewport the TAGLIA size cards sit below the fold when 'Giornata / più giorni' mode is active (hero + description + mode + GIORNO + DAL GIORNO + NUMERO DI GIORNI pushes TAGLIA offscreen). The CTA label correctly becomes 'Scegli la taglia' hinting to scroll, but it is not visually obvious. Consider auto-scrolling to TAGLIA when CTA is tapped without a size, or collapsing description.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Appears repeatedly. Reference: multiple style definitions using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.

React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - triggered after login navigation. Likely from a Modal/overlay (e.g., toast/modal in src/toast.tsx or confirm modal in bookings.tsx).

action_items: Preserve post-login intent: in login screen or auth store, when login is reached from 'Prenota ora', after successful auth navigate to /checkout with the pending booking params (currently it goes back to /bike/[id]).
Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to the new boxShadow API (or Platform.select) to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Replace deprecated pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents in whichever component triggers it (likely overlay/modal).
Optional: On book-now with no size selected in daily mode, auto-scroll to the TAGLIA section for better discoverability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py parse_range() uses datetime.now().date() (naive, server timezone) to compare with user-provided local date; while acceptable, consider documenting that 'date' is in Europe/Rome local time to avoid edge cases at midnight.
Admin seed is idempotent via $setOnInsert (good). Bike seeding runs only when collection is empty (good).
booked_counts projection excludes _id and selects size (good). Availability subtraction correctly clamped at 0.
StripeCheckout uses emergentintegrations (as expected); session URL returned contains 'stripe.com' confirming real test session (verified via backend test).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% - all flows verified; one UX issue (post-login redirect) + RN Web deprecation warnings

seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeds 4 bikes and admin user (idempotent). Tests create TEST_user_* accounts via register and TEST_Bike entries that are cleaned up (delete) within the admin CRUD test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py as regression. Mobile viewport is 390x844. testIDs are complete across all screens.
rca_of_issue: Post-login UX friction RCA: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx line 73 uses router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/'). When book-now triggers router.push('/login'), after a successful submit the login screen calls router.replace('/') (or similar) which pops back to /bike/[id] rather than forwarding to /checkout. Fix: pass a return/redirect param (e.g., router.push({pathname:'/login', params:{redirect:'/checkout', ...bookingDraft}})) and after login navigate to that path with the pre-selected booking state.
